notes:
Adds an animated AirPods connection card for supported Bluetooth audio devices.
Adds Codex device-code sign-in and a compact top-bar usage indicator that
refreshes every 300 seconds. Authentication remains owned by Codex; ZeusOS
does not read or store account tokens. Also includes the previously promoted
one-shot Shut Down to Boot Chooser action. Version remains 0.1.0-preview.2.
